access_and_selection_declaration.numerical_output_policy: Only identifiers, counts, input conditions, units, calibration/protocol constants and source/container hashes were retained. All numerical reaction responses, fitted kinetic constants, error values, p-values and model scores were suppressed.

access_and_selection_declaration.lineage_caveat: Public conclusions informed the search. Any later use is paper-informed replication unless a stronger discovery claim is independently justified. Prior exposure through existing source-template parameters or earlier datasets remains unaudited.

network_and_tool_summary.bibliographic_queries: Bounded Europe PMC REST core-search queries for the named Smallbone/van Eunen/Xu/Cereghetti/Oliveira studies, cited kinetics-informatics paper, EnzymeML papers and a targeted GPD/GND kinetic-paper query
network_and_tool_summary.publication_projection: Python standard-library HTTP and XML parsing; preinstalled pypdf for selected publication/methods PDF text; output restricted to metadata/input conditions or numerical-redacted text
network_and_tool_summary.bounds: HTTP calls used timeout=25 seconds or curl --max-time 25 --connect-timeout 10. GitHub access used gh; subsequent gh calls were wrapped in a 25-second subprocess timeout. No installs or authentication/challenge bypasses.
network_and_tool_summary.query_error: One Europe PMC targeted search used an unsupported sort parameter and returned no hitCount; retried once without that parameter. No data-derived decision resulted.
network_and_tool_summary.repository_operations: Initial pwd/ls/git status and metadata file reads; new JSON files only. Repository contained unrelated existing edits, left untouched.

required_parent_follow_up: Review the three provisional lead metadata files without treating them as registered candidates.
Obtain author/source metadata-only record inventories and independently controlled access; insist on raw-file provenance rather than inventing checksums or biological IDs.
Resolve the Cdc19 source discrepancy/correction and actual assay temperature; resolve exact pH, enzyme amounts, normalization and raw-data availability for the other leads.

Document biological source, preparation, assay randomization unit, technical read and shared calibration relations separately. Shared batches are not automatically duplicates; independent biological counts cannot be inferred from technical N.
If no appropriately scoped candidate satisfies the protocol, stop at ineligibility. Do not relax protocol criteria or fit summary constants to manufacture a native-law result.
